page.overview:
Who is Phlegethon?

Phlegethon (known as Acheron before version 2.3), is a historical character in Final Fantasy XIV. Phlegethon was a hero of the rebellion that sought to oppose the rule of Allagan Empire in the Third Astral Era. After his capture by the technologist Amon, his body altered and mind broken, fated to become an eternal guardian of the Crystal Tower.

Phlegethon was leader of one of many rebellions that erupted in the waning years of the Allagan Empire. Phlegethon was treated as a hero by the rebels, and as such the general was considered a murderous villain by the Allagans. On the battlefield, Phlegethon fought several battles against General Artorius of the Allagan army, developing a bond of mutual respect. Artorius didn't agree with the direction the empire was taking, and when rumors of his relationship with Phlegethon reached the ears of the high command, the latter sent an assassin to end Artorius' life. Artorius' heart was pierced by the trigger weapon Excalibur. The power of the eikon twisted Artorius' body into a grotesque shape and destroyed his mind, reducing him to a puppet. Artorius was then controlled and used to crush the rebellion and capture Phlegethon. After being captured, Amon forcibly modified Phlegethon's body through sorcery and science, Phlegethon's mind was broken and conditioned to obey. Phlegethon became one of the guardians of the Crystal Tower..|name=Orthos Unveiled}}

After the event of the Seventh Umbral Era, Garlond Ironworks funded the Adventurers' journey into the Labyrinth of the Ancients where they face Phlegethon at the Hall of the Inexorable leading to the base of the Tower itself.

Phlegethon appears as a giant, golden humanoid wielding a large curved blade and black patterns or tattoos across his body. His blueish cape seems to be attached to his red collar. He has yellow hair.
